'''"Protector X" law enforcement armor''' was an [[Armor/Legends|armor]] produced by [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]] and used by [[Rebel trooper/Legends|rebel troopers]] and many [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was a common sight in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="Edge of the Empire" />
